wish: someone should make a password generator that makes memorable passwords
spec:
Makes a passphrase of random everyday words from a built-in list of 1143, using the device random generator, and shows its strength in bits.
Choose 3 to 8 words, the separator, capitals and two digits; tap New one until one sticks, then Copy.
It never asks for your existing password, sends nothing, and never saves generated passwords; only the settings are remembered.
notes: Word list embedded (1143 words, ~10.2 bits each). Randomness from crypto.getRandomValues with rejection sampling. localStorage holds only word count, separator and toggles.
